# PocketMage SDK

> Generated by docmd

## Documentation Files

- [Built-in asset bitmaps (libAssets.h)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/assets/)
  Compiled-in PROGMEM bitmaps for the status bar, screensavers, and battery gauge.
- [Buzzer (pocketmage_bz)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/bz/)
  PWM buzzer output, Note/Jingle data model, and the built-in melodies.
- [Clock (pocketmage_clock)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/clock/)
  The PCF8563 RTC: reading, setting, validity, and the auto-sleep timer bookkeeping.
- [Configuration](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/configuration/)
  Compile-time pins and knobs in config.h, persistent preference globals, and how an app sees the SDK version.
- [E-Ink (pocketmage_eink)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/eink/)
  The 320x240 GDEQ031T10 panel: PocketmageEink, the background refresh task, and refresh policy.
- [Fonts & Text (pocketmage_font)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/font/)
  FontStyle roles, DisplayTarget, the FontEngine static API, and the default font table.
- [Frames (frames.h)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/frames/)
  The Frame data model and the e-ink text/bitmap rendering engine.
- [Internationalization (i18n)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/i18n-runtime/)
  Lang/StringID tables, the TR() lookup, runtime language switching, and command aliases.
- [API Reference](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/)
  Every component an app links against: the umbrella header, the singleton accessors, and the per-component pages.
- [Text utilities (pocketmage_io)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/io/)
  Small string helpers apps use for command parsing and data marshaling.
- [Keyboard (pocketmage_kb)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/kb/)
  The TCA8418 matrix keyboard and USB HID stack: modifiers, key events, and scanning.
- [Layout (pocketmage_layout)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/layout/)
  Canonical display geometry, the row-pitch helper, and the text-fit free functions.
- [OLED (pocketmage_oled)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/oled/)
  The 256x32 SSD1326 OLED: PocketmageOled class, the u8g2 object, and the status line.
- [SD card (pocketmage_sd)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/sd/)
  Filesystems, files, metadata, and the dual SDMMC/SDSPI mode switch.
- [System (pocketmage_sys, pocketmage_globals)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/sys/)
  Peripheral init, CPU speed, deep sleep, crash recovery, and the shared global state.
- [Touch (pocketmage_touch)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/touch/)
  The MPR121 capacitive slider: scroll offsets, line scrolling, and gesture vectors.
- [UI helpers (pocketmage_ui)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/ui/)
  Screen scaffolding, scrollbars, list rows, inverted chips, and the OLED cycle picker.
- [WiFi (pocketmage_wifi)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/api/wifi/)
  The station radio service: enabled/scan/connect lifecycle, status queries, and saved credentials.
- [App binary contract (ABI)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/app-abi/)
  The binary shape the loader accepts, how it is mapped and run, and the failure modes that bite.
- [Building an app](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/build/)
  The toolchain, the project layout, and the make targets that produce a shippable ELF and tar.
- [PocketMage SDK guides](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/guides/)
  How to build apps, understand their lifecycle, and draw to both displays.
- [App lifecycle](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/guides/lifecycle/)
  Entry points, build-time vs host symbols, the APP_INIT hook, and how an app exits.
- [Making an app](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/guides/making-apps/)
  Scaffold, build, pack, and run your first PocketMage app.
- [Rendering](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/guides/rendering/)
  Which draw calls go where, the E-Ink buffered refresh model, and the scroll loop.
- [Internationalization (i18n)](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/i18n/)
  Translation catalogs, the gen_i18n.py generator, ownership rules, and what the merge validates.
- [PocketMage SDK Documentation](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/)
  Official SDK for building PocketMage apps: guides, the full component API reference, the ELF app contract, and publishing.
- [Migrating an existing app](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/migration/)
  Moving a pre-ELF app to the runtime-load flow: what changed, the eight steps, and the traps that bite.
- [Publishing an app](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/publish/)
  The delivery tar, the 40x40 icon, asset sharing, and what APPLOADER does with them on the device.
- [Symbols and the dependency contract](https://talismandesign.github.io/PocketMage_SDK/docs/symbols/)
  The host-export surface apps resolve against, how third-party libraries link, and the rules for changing the surface.
